title: Breakfast burrito with egg and beans
steps: Rinse the beans and warm them in a small pan with 2 tbsp water and a pinch of salt, mashing them roughly.
Beat the eggs and cook them into soft scrambled eggs in a non-stick pan.
Dice the tomato and mash the avocado with lime juice and chilli flakes.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the beans, eggs, tomato, avocado and grated cheese and roll up.
